comment-1: Expected target/reference ratio per diagram, with tolerance. The workflow marks rows outside band in the summary; nothing fails. Update these deliberately when a change legitimately moves performance, in the same commit as the change (or the reference bump).
comment-2: Tolerance calibrated 2026-08-29 from 4 identical-engine (A/A) runs on 4 distinct runner CPU models (Xeon 8370C, EPYC 9V74, Xeon 6973P-C, EPYC 7763): worst observed A/A deviation was 0.07, most rows within 0.05. 0.10 sits above that noise floor while still flagging real regressions.
